title: The Vending Machine mod
description: this mod adds Vending Machines to minecraft and you can bye sodas that have different effects
body:
this mod adds Vending Machines to minecraft and you can bye sodas that have different effects.

to make a vending machine you need 6 Vending ingots, 2 iron ingots, and 1 redstone dust
(the crafting recipe is...) vending ingot = V iron ingot = I redstone = R

V V V
I R I
V V V


vending ore and money ore can be found anywere above deepslate.

RedSoda places lava on you.
BlueSoda places water on you.
YellowSoda summons lighting on you.


there is also Vending armor!
